versions.changelog:
- Clarified the "Optional Ritual Cloud upgrade" section for improved guidance on when and why to use Ritual Cloud, including clearer standalone mode language.
- Updated instructions for enabling Ritual Cloud for greater readability.
- No changes to logic or functionality; documentation only.
- Version number unchanged in metadata.

Initial release of backend-test-plan skill.

- Converts backend changes into verifiable success criteria and a minimum useful test set (unit, integration, contract, migration).
- Provides principles to create focused, risk-driven tests and avoid unnecessary combinatorial coverage.
- Includes detailed steps and a sample prompt for local, standalone use—no setup or external dependencies required.
- Offers optional knowledge capture to save reusable findings as OKF notes with user approval.
- Includes guidance on when to upgrade to Ritual Cloud for broader context or structured decisions.
